messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for service=router image=redwood/router:v3.2.0 env=prod change-window=2026-04-12T01:00Z-03:00Z. Feature gate 'routing_v2' default=off. Smoke tests running. @ada @simon
ada: ETA for smoke results? I'll watch traces and spans.
simon: Plan proposal: enable gate 3% -> 10% -> 50% over 20m / 40m / 60m if stable. Rollback if p95 > 1200ms or error rate > 0.5%. Pin back to v3.1.9 on rollback.
maya: Adding an automated watch: if p99 increases >20% for 10m, auto-toggle off. I'll push the rule to LaunchGate.
deploy-bot: Smoke run completed: all checks passed. No exceptions. Preparing to set routing_v2 -> 3% (eu-west).
ops-lead: Prefer starting EU first, then US. No DB migrations in this release right?
jun: Correct, no migrations. Starting with eu-west 3% now.
ada: Snippet to set gate (use FLAG_API token): `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.com/api/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_API' -d '{"id":"routing_v2","state":"on","percent":3,"region":"eu-west"}'`
simon: Confirmed: routing_v2 = 3% in eu-west. Metrics after 10m: p50 +2%, p95 +12% — within thresholds.
maya: Watch rule created, alert target #eng-oncall if p95 > 1200ms for 5m.
deploy-bot: Increasing gate to 10% across eu-west and us-west now. Notifying tracing and dashboards.
ada: Suggest pinning experiment header for a subset: set X-RW-Experiment:v2 for 2h to avoid broad split exposures.
simon: Pinning implemented (header pin, 2h) and fallback to old route when header absent.
jun: Seeing a small error spike in us-west: error rate 0.7% and elevated 502s. Rolling us-west back to 0% immediately.
simon: Rolled back us-west to 0%. EU remains 10%. Investigating 502 traces — appears to be long tail from LB->worker.
maya: If it persists I'll open incident and add runbook. For now keep EU cohort and observe for 15m.
ada: Release notes snippet for v3.2.0: "improved prefix caching, changed header parsing; no DB changes; partial region rollout."
ops-lead: Decision: hold global rollout. Keep eu-west at 10%, disable us-west. Cancel scheduled automatic step to 50%. Tag release notes with the us-west rollback note.
deploy-bot: Gate status update: eu-west=10%, us-west=0%. Next steps require manual approval.
simon: I'll follow up with a short RCA if root cause confirmed. If it's service-mesh-related we may need to pin sidecar to previous image.
nada: Posting short blurb to #release-notes: "v3.2.0 partial rollout: EU subset active; US rollout paused due to transient 502s; monitoring ongoing."
jun: Proposal: try a more gradual full rollout in the next change window 2026-04-13T01:00Z-03:00Z with 1% increments and extended observation. +1 if OK.
ops-lead: :thumbsup: Tentative schedule set. Re-evaluate after 2h of observation and RCA.
